messages.subject: ctmm workshop at AWMS 2024 (Australia)
parts:
Dear all,

There will be a 4-day continuous-time movement modeling (ctmm) workshop in coordination with the Australian Wildlife Management Society (AWMS) 2024 conference:  https://awms.org.au/conference/. The AWMS conference will run Dec. 3-5 in Fremantle, Perth, and the ctmm workshop will take place the following week Dec. 9-12 at Murdoch University, Perth.

There will soon by a link to a registration page at https://awms.org.au/conference/, but in the interim you can email Roy Teale (r...@biota.net.au) with an expression of interest, and he will let you know when registration becomes available. The location is confirmed and the cost will be approximately $800 AUD.

Best,
Chris
